title: Completed matching sections lift modulo the maximal ideal
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative local ring, U its punctured spectrum, C its maximal-ideal completion, q:Y→U and s:E→Spec C finite, and D an overlap identification as in [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Put g:C→Γ(E) equal to the structural map and F=D.completedRingMap as in [def-sbc-completed-matching-ring-map]. Every b∈Γ(E) admits a in the source of F with F(a)−b∈m_C Γ(E), the ideal mapped along g. This asserts lifting only in the quotient Γ(E)/m_C Γ(E).

One exact generic Nakayama lemma, used by the parent to upgrade residue lifting. It does not establish residue lifting.

theorem completedRingMap_residue_lift
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) :
    ∀ b : Γ(E, ⊤), ∃ a, D.completedRingMap a - b ∈
      (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A)).map
        (((ΓSpecIso (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))).inv ≫
          s.appTop).hom)
